messages:
cara: Heads-up — APAC vendor just told us IEC power certification pushback. They can only clear ~50% of the rack shipment this week, rest delayed 2–3w. They want to deliver partial batches and invoice as shipped. Need decision on partial acceptance + any credits.

alex: Ugh. Which racks/POs affected? Any specific SKUs or just a bulk hold?

cara: It's PO# RWI-4432, all 48U standard racks for the APAC Dedicated fleet. Vendor says units with our modified PDUs hit extra testing. They can segregate certified units now.

maria: If we accept half, we can try canary deploys in SIN and run a limited rollout. But eng-infra needs time to validate power profiles. @maria to @alex: how quickly can you validate 6 racks?

alex: I can get a basic power smoke on 6 racks within 48 hours if courier drops them at our SIN staging partner. Need clearance to pull them forward.

samir: Sales/si side: several SI pilots depend on that capacity next month. If we accept partial, we should reserve the certified lot for pilot customers and swap non-certified to internal dev clusters.

evan: From a BizOps perspective, vendor credit negotiation can be a % credit on delayed units or expedited freight carveout. Prefer credit + freight on vendor.

irene: Logistics note: staggered delivery means two invoices and two manifests. Customs on APAC side may require separate bills of lading. That increases handling fees ~$1.2k/batch.

jordan: Customer success here — pilots can be shifted by 1 week if we communicate ASAP. But one enterprise customer has a hard go-live on week+2. We should avoid impacting them.

cara: Proposal: accept 24 racks now (ship+invoice), validate 6 as canary in SIN, allocate next 18 to pilot customers, and hold remaining 24 until cert cleared. Negotiate 5% credit on delayed units + vendor covers one-way expedited freight if they miss the 2w window. Thoughts?

alex: I'm okay with that plan if eng-infra signs off on canary within 48h.

maria: I can validate canary within 36h if racks arrive by EOD tomorrow. Need a staging ETA and rack serial list.

irene: I'll ask vendor for a split manifest and earliest pickup. Also will push back on them to absorb customs extra fees — we shouldn't eat that.

evan: I'll own the credit ask and draft the email now. Can you @irene confirm the manifest when vendor replies?

cara: @evan nice. small correction: cara: I'll take the communications to the SI pilots and set expectations. @samir please compile the pilot list and priority order.

samir: On it — sending list in a separate DM. Quick Q: can we assign temporary burst capacity from hosted API while we wait? Might help enterprise go-live.

jordan: Hosted burst could work as a bridge for control-plane, but not for data-residency/air-gapped needs. I'll flag which customers can accept hosted fallback.

maria: Also adding: when we bring partial racks online, toggle power-safety limiter to conservative profile. Will need config push to devices: runbook snippet below:

```
# conservative power profile
pdu.set_profile('redwood-limited-90pct')
monitor.set_threshold('line-drop', 0.12)
```

alex: Good call. @maria can you attach the monitoring dashboard when ready so SRE can watch the canary?

maria: Yep — will share dashboard link and alert policy once canary validation starts.

irene: Vendor replied: pickup tom noon for 24 units, remaining on hold. They're okay to issue split manifest. Asking for confirmation by EOD or depot reschedule fee applies.

cara: Ok, we confirm: accept 24 now. Action owners: @irene confirm pickup + manifest, @maria validate canary, @evan negotiate credit, @samir map pilots, @alex coordinate sin staging. I'll draft external note to vendor + internal exec heads.

evan: Drafting vendor note now. I'll request 5% credit and vendor pickup of customs/handling fees. Will cc legal if they push back.

alex: SIN staging ready but need SKUs/serials. @irene drop serials to logistics channel ASAP.

irene: Will post manifest + serial list in logistics channel in 30m. Also flagged vendor fee pushback to procurement.

jordan: I'll prepare customer comms templates for impacted pilots and the one enterprise with hard date.

cara: Thanks team. We'll reconvene if vendor pushes back on credit. If they don't confirm manifest by EOD, we pivot to reschedule and escalate SLA credits for impacted pilots.
